entities.name: Protected piperazine substrate
observations: The structure is an ethoxycarbonyl-protected piperazine attached to a fused N-heteroaromatic system bearing a fluorophenyl substituent.

entities.name: Basic carbamate hydrolysis
observations: Methoxypropanol, water, KOH, and heat are used as basic hydrolysis/deprotection conditions.
Methoxypropanol is solvent; water and KOH provide the hydrolytic basic medium.

entities.name: Piperazine carbamate deprotection
observations: The ethoxycarbonyl group is removed from the protected piperazine nitrogen, converting N(CO2Et) to NH.
The expected net change is cleavage of the piperazine N-carbamate bond with loss of the ethoxycarbonyl fragment.

entities.name: Deprotected piperazine product
observations: The product retains the fluorophenyl-fused N-heteroaromatic core and has a secondary piperazine NH.
